svg.title: CPU16 computer: architecture
svg.desc: The whole computer: seven boards plug into the same backplane. The CPU drives the address and memory control; the memory board maps the address to a physical address through the bank registers and decodes the I/O space; the cache stalls the CPU on a miss; the I/O and video boards talk through registers in the FFxx space. The inside of the CPU board has its own diagram.
